announcements.title: Welcome Back — Session 2026-2027
announcements.body: Welcome to a new academic session. Classes commence September 3, 2026. All cadets must report by 8:00 AM.

announcements.title: Eid-ul-Adha Holiday Notice
announcements.body: The institution will remain closed June 15–19 on account of Eid-ul-Adha. Caretaker duty roster is attached.

announcements.title: Annual Sports Gala — Registrations Open
announcements.body: Annual Sports Gala scheduled for November 22–23, 2026. All cadets encouraged to participate. Forms at PT office.

announcements.title: Fee Submission Deadline — October 2026
announcements.body: Please clear October fee challans by October 10. Late fee penalties will apply thereafter.

announcements.title: Staff Meeting — November 5
announcements.body: All teaching staff must attend the academic committee meeting on November 5 at 11:00 AM in the Conference Room.

noticeboard_items.content: Trials for Inter-House Cricket Championship will be held on October 3 & 4. Report to Main Ground at 15:00.

noticeboard_items.title: Parents' Day — November 29, 2026
noticeboard_items.content: Annual Parents' Day is scheduled for November 29. Invitations will be sent home last week of October.

noticeboard_items.title: Library Hours Extended
noticeboard_items.content: Library open until 20:00 on weekdays to support Term 1 examinations.

noticeboard_items.title: Dengue Prevention Advisory
noticeboard_items.content: Cadets are requested to use mosquito repellent after dusk. Report any symptoms to sick bay immediately.
